per_arm_gate.preconditions_scope_note: interpretation.preconditions carries the GREEN arm(s) only (ARM_OFF). The RED arm(s) (ARM_STRICT_FLAG_OFF, ARM_REPLAY_ON) are carried in full at top level under per_arm_gate.red, and their criteria are marked load_bearing:false + criteria_non_degenerate:false. The indexer's _compute_adjudication reads interpretation.preconditions FLAT and ARM-BLIND and returns precondition_unmet for the WHOLE RUN on the first unmet entry, so including a scored-out arm's failure here would re-vacate the green arm at adjudication time.

preconditions.name: ARM_STRICT_FLAG_OFF::episode_outcome_spread_supra_floor
preconditions.description: MECH-323's evaluative gate is RELATIVE to a running baseline, so real chunk formation (a precursor to any replay-origin test) is structurally impossible on a flat outcome stream. Same statistic as V3-EXQ-810a.
preconditions.control: worst seed in this arm; the hazard/resource grid's per-episode net signal varies

preconditions.name: ARM_STRICT_FLAG_OFF::chunk_buffer_supports_size_range
preconditions.description: Same buffer-reachability precondition as V3-EXQ-810a: a per-trial buffer shorter than chunk_max_size makes the tracked-sequence tally too shallow to hold a genuine repeated high-value candidate.
preconditions.control: worst seed in this arm; e3_steps_per_tick periodicity

preconditions.name: ARM_STRICT_FLAG_OFF::replay_high_value_candidate_available
preconditions.description: MECH-322 condition (a)'s own precondition: at the sleep checkpoint, at least one tracked real sub-sequence must have an outcome mean clearing ChunkAccumulator.replay_value_threshold() (the SAME statistic condition (a) itself compares against) or PROBE 2 (the should-succeed cell) is structurally unattemptable this seed.
preconditions.control: worst seed in this arm; measured as the tracked candidate's margin above the threshold (mu - threshold), so a seed with no candidate at all reads a large negative sentinel rather than a missing value
